text:
gina: Heads up — noticed quota consumption in console jumped for a handful of customers after last night's routing-policy rollout. numbers look ~2x for some tenants. :question:
harry: Wow, which metric skewed? tokens, requests, or RU?
gina: The per-tenant "quota_used" metric on the console. It went from ~1.2M to ~2.4M for tenant-42 between 03:00-04:00 UTC.
isabel: Could be unit mismatch between service (measuring token-units) and the Go SDK (reporting request-units). We changed the default quota unit to "ru" in platform config, but SDKs weren't updated.
jun: Confirming: platform emits x-rd-quota-unit: ru now. Go SDK still interprets RU as "multiplier 1" while runtime expects RU= token_count/512. so clients reported raw token counts as RU which double-counts.
gina: I see logs from quota-ingest showing both kinds of events:
```
# example events
ingest: tenant=tenant-42 unit=token amount=2300
ingest: tenant=tenant-42 unit=ru amount=2300
```
ginA: (typo in my message) sorry. but you get the idea.
harry: Ok — possible mitigation: platform can accept both units for 24h and normalize server-side. Or we make SDKs send explicit normalized_ru field.
isabel: Quick fix path: platform accepts legacy 'token' unit and if unit=="token" convert amount -> ru = ceil(tokens / 512). we'll backfill for last 2 hours. Longer term we want SDKs to emit unit=ru and normalized units.
kyle: I'll draft Go SDK patch to interpret x-rd-quota-unit header and, if missing, default to legacy behavior. also bump go-sdk to 0.9.2 with tests.
jun: Also need to add telemetry label sdk_lang and sdk_version to quota events so console can split totals by SDK version. current ingestion only tags tenant + region.
gina: product UX: console tenants with >=10% deviation from invoice baseline should show a yellow banner and a link to "quarantine" ingestion while we backfill.
harry: We should not backfill automatically into customer billing without manual approval. Flagging + manual diff review first.
isabel: agreed. We'll compute a suggested correction delta and present as a reviewable change.
kyle: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/pull/211 adding header parsing and unit conversion. tests included.
jun: I'll open a platform change to accept both units and add a migration job to reconcile the 03:00-05:00 window.
gina: Telemetry team: sampling is 0.5% currently for quota-event traces. bump to 5% for the next 3 hours so we can get better signal on SDK versions and host variants.
isabel: Also add a console dashboard tile for "quota-unit-mismatch rate" (events where unit != configured_unit). That helps catch future rollouts.
kyle: Hotfix strategy: release go-sdk 0.9.2 with compat parsing. then release python 0.22.1 note: python already patched in #942. want coordinated announcement.
harry: Can we include a migration note in console rollout UI? "Quota unit change — SDKs must accept 'ru' or send legacy tokens. We will support both for 48h."
gina: yes, add to rollout tile copy. also notify early access customers via email.
jun: deploy-bot: rolling back the quota-unit-only enforcement in region-us-west at 2026-03-22T02:12:00Z to accept legacy tokens for 48h.
deploy-bot: Quota-unit enforcement rollback applied to us-west at 2026-03-22T02:12:00Z :white_check_mark:
kyle: merging go-sdk patch after CI. tagging release notes: "compat: accept legacy quota tokens and respect x-rd-quota-unit header".
isabel: follow-up tasks: 1) reconciliation job 2) console banner copy 3) telemetry sampling bump 4) SDK releases 5) billing review workflow.
gina: I'll coordinate a short post-rollout checklist doc and assign tasks.
harry: Add a small alert in console for "sudden quota usage delta > 25%" to autopage oncall in future.
jun: noted. scheduling a short retro tomorrow to prevent unit rename surprises. :calendar:
